--Dashboard Đợt thi sát hạch của NHNCK
SELECT P.IDENTITY_NUMBER, 
ES.CODE || ES.NAME AS DOT_THI,
ES."YEAR" || ES.SESSION_ AS KY_THI,
ES.EXAM_START_DATE AS NGAY_BAT_DAU_THI,
ES.Exam_End_Date AS NGAY_KET_THUC_THI,
ED.LAW_SCORE AS DIEM_THI_LUAT, ED.LAW_RESULT AS KQ_THI_LUAT,
ED.SPECIALIZATION_SCORE AS DIEM_THI_CHUYEN_MON,
ED.SPECIALIZATION_RESULT AS KQ_THI_CHUYEN_MON,
D.DECISION_NUMBER AS SO_QD,
CASE 
WHEN ED.RESULT = '-1' THEN 'KHÔNG THI'
WHEN ED.RESULT ='1' THEN 'ĐẠT'
WHEN ED.RESULT ='0' THEN 'KHÔNG ĐẠT'
END AS KET_QUA_THI
FROM NHNCK_UAT.PROFESSIONALS P 
JOIN NHNCK_UAT.EXAM_DETAILS ED ON p.ID = ED.PROFESSIONAL_ID 
JOIN NHNCK_UAT.EXAM_SESSIONS ES ON ES.ID = ED.EXAM_SESSION_ID 
JOIN NHNCK_UAT.DECISIONS D ON D.ID = ES.DECISION_ID 
--WHERE P.IDENTITY_NUMBER ='075184000613'
;

SELECT P.FULL_NAME,P.IDENTITY_NUMBER ,SD.FULL_NAME , SD.IDENTITY_NUMBER ,
C.COURSE_CODE, C.COURSE_NAME, 
R.TRAINING_HOURS,
CASE 
WHEN R.TRAINING_HOURS >= '8' THEN 'Đã đủ 8h: Số giờ cập nhật/năm >=8h'
ELSE 'Chưa đủ 8h: Số giờ cập nhật/năm)'
END AS TRANG_THAI_8H,
R.CLASSIFICATION_RESULT, R.RESULT_STATUS , 
SD."RESULT" AS KQ_PLOAI
,R.START_DATE,R.END_DATE 
FROM --QLNHN_UAT.SPECIALIZATION_COURSES 
NHNCK_UAT.POST_CERT_TRAINING_RESULTS R
JOIN NHNCK_UAT.Professionals P ON P.ID = R.PROFESSIONAL_ID 
JOIN NHNCK_UAT.POST_CERT_TRAINING_COURSES C ON C.ID = R.TRAINING_COURSE_ID 
JOIN NHNCK_UAT.SPECIALIZATION_COURSE_DETAILS sd ON SD.PROFESSIONAL_ID = P.ID 
WHERE SD.IDENTITY_NUMBER ='033193008601'
;
